plugins.name: pushpin
plugins.description: Thumbtack's Pushpin design system as an invokable skill. Ships 300 design tokens generated from the Pushpin Thumbprint UI Kit Figma file — colors in light and dark, a responsive type ramp, spacing, radius, elevation, and motion — plus a catalog of all 117 published Figma components and a verified path for generating Figma layouts from real library instances.
